fullContentHtml:
SSC Selection Post Phase-XIV Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Answer Key for the Various Selection Post Phase 14th. This recruitment was released for 3003 posts. Applications for the SSC Selection Post 14th Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 13 April 2026, to 4 May 2026. The online examination was held on 16-26 September 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can download their SSC Selection Post 14th Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 13 April 2026
  • Last Date : 04 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 May 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 11-13 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 16-26 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 08 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 14 September 2026
  • Answer Key : 09 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 0/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 0/-

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.

What is SSC Selection Post Phase-XIV Answer Key 2026?

SSC Selection Post Phase-XIV Answer Key 2026 contains the official answers. Candidates can verify their responses and submit objections if required.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
